title: Axiomatic Foundation of Intent Dynamics
subtitle: A Mathematical Framework for Reality, Life, and Persistence

blocks.text: This chapter presents the poster “Axiomatic Foundation of Intent Dynamics” in full. It is a single dense diagram; open it, then use the explanation, read-aloud, and Ask-AI tools beneath it to work through the ideas at your own pace.

blocks.alt: Poster: Axiomatic Foundation of Intent Dynamics — A Mathematical Framework for Reality, Life, and Persistence
blocks.caption: Figure 1.1 — Axiomatic Foundation of Intent Dynamics: A Mathematical Framework for Reality, Life, and Persistence.
blocks.explanation: This poster states the three axioms the whole trilogy rests on. Axiom I posits a material manifold M, the substrate of physical realization, with state x in M. Axiom II posits an energy functional on the tangent bundle giving the law of motion x-dot = f(x,u). Axiom III posits intent as a primitive living on its own Riemannian semantic manifold (Sigma, g_Sigma), joined to matter only through the realization operator R : Sigma x M -> Sigma. From these follows the Principle of Stationary Intent, delta J = 0, with intent Lagrangian L = q(x) + lambda D(I, I-hat(x)) + half u-transpose R u, and its Legendre transform the intent Hamiltonian. The lower half recasts the trilogy as three boundary-value problems — existence D(I0, empty) > 0, stability D(I, I-hat(t)) <= epsilon, and invariance D_Sigma(I, I) = 0 — and derives three results: the semantic persistence functional P(t) = exp(-D(I, I-hat)), the full decoupling of physical distance from semantic distance, and the no-compiler principle, that optimal realization is a dynamical trajectory rather than an imposed software layer.
blocks.tts: The axiomatic foundation of intent dynamics. Three axioms — a material manifold, an energy functional, and intent as a primitive on its own semantic manifold — yield the Principle of Stationary Intent and recast the trilogy as three boundary-value problems: existence, stability, and invariance.
